notes.title: Mosaic of The Pharaohs – Out on Friday
notes.content:
[h2]🌴🐪 [i]Mosaic of The Pharaohs[/i] is nearly here! 🐍🏜️
[/h2]
Explore the mysteries of Ancient Egypt in this all-new epic mosaic puzzle, launching on Steam for $8.99, 28th March 2025 at 5:30pm UTC!

[previewyoutube=26sL9iam0Rk;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]From the Pyramids of Giza to the secrets of the Valley of the Kings, every region you solve reveals a fragment of the past.[/b]

🖼️ Piece together a breathtaking 60,000-tile collage of the wonders of Ancient Egypt, uncovering 100 fascinating facts about its myths, gods, monuments, explorers and more.

🎶 Whether you're engrossed in your favourite podcasts or listening to your favourite tunes, Mosaic of The Pharaohs serves as the perfect backdrop to enhance your experience. Or choose the soothing built-in desert soundtrack.

⏳ Dozens of Hours of Addictive Gameplay: Get ready to lose yourself in hours of simple, calming but addictive puzzle-solving, with 100 achievements to collect!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45178511/d288d23dc8d4636130f06e57470882c6aaf04aa9.png[/img]

[h3]Add it to your wishlist now to avoid missing the 10% launch discount! 👇[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3530670/Mosaic_of_The_Pharaohs/

notes.title: Update 1.1.02081
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in which double-clicking on a tile could cause a mismatch between a tile’s visual state and its "true" state.
[*] Using Ctrl+Z to undo no longer triggers the zoom-in keyboard shortcut at the same time.
[*] Fixed the undo feature panning the camera to random locations instead of undoing your moves.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.01102
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed the missing % symbol on the main menu in some languages
[*] Z and X now function as keyboard shortcuts for zooming in and out
[*] Added button to the settings menu linking to the [url=https://discord.gg/KMFVU333ty]Discord[/url].
[*] Added button to the settings menu linking to the [url=https://dividetheplunder.com/sendy/subscription?f=19uoLkFrtwjFX2hXnkFALMnNTkahOv1A3JeTJG6m4LnbSDjKwONC6qgGEmg92AAl]Mailing List[/url], where you can subscribe to hear about new games in the series.

notes.title: Update 1.1.01040
notes.content:
This update addresses a couple of issues raised by the community:

[list]
[*] Tile and error colours have been adjusted to improve contrast.
[*] The error sound effect no longer plays when error detection is turned off.
[/list]
I also just wanted to wish you all a Happy New Year, and say a huge thank you to everyone that has so generously donated to the UNICEF fundraiser so far!

notes.title: 2024: Mosaic Retrospective is out now!
notes.content:
[b]🎉 [i]2024: Mosaic Retrospective[/i] is out now! 🎉[/b]

Hi everyone!  
I’m thrilled to announce the release of [i]2024: Mosaic Retrospective[/i], the third entry in the [i]Mega Mosaic[/i] series! This new game is a special way to wrap up the year, and I’ve been working hard to create something truly unique.

🧩 [b]A Full 60,000-Tile Puzzle[/b]
This is a massive Mega Mosaic puzzle with 60,000 tiles to complete. The best part? It’s [b]completely free[/b] to download and play!

[b]🔍 Discover Global Stories from 2024 [/b]
As you work through the puzzle, you’ll slowly reveal a huge pixel art collage showcasing the biggest news stories from 2024. From politics to sports, climate change to pop culture, every piece contributes to this unique retrospective of the year. This year had no shortage of huge news, and I've worked hard to cram nearly a hundred stories this puzzle.

[b]🎶 Soothing Soundtrack[/b]
Unwind with your favorite podcasts or music while tackling the puzzle. Or enjoy the game's choice of [b]two[/b] relaxing built-in soundtracks.

[b]💖 A Fundraiser for UNICEF[/b]
All I ask in return is that, if you enjoy the game, please consider donating to my fundraiser for UNICEF. Help me reach my goal of raising £2,000 to support this incredible cause!

[b]👉 Get it now on Steam![/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3380760/2024_Mosaic_Retrospective/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3380760/2024_Mosaic_Retrospective/
[/url]
Together, let’s look back at 2024 and help make a difference with UNICEF! 🎁

Thank you for your support, and happy puzzling!
